title: 第17章 猎蛛
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
陈峰出了学校，手机震了一下。

    取件提醒。

    “您有一件快递已到达青云小区驿站，请及时领取。”

    发件方：周记铸坊。

    刀终于到了！

    陈峰目光微亮，心中一喜。

    他之前订购的其他装备都已经到了，就只差这把刀。

    只要刀到手，一切准备妥当，他就能回去大墟世界，弄死那头猎影蛛了！

    足足十二天没有前往大墟世界，他甚至开始有些怀念大墟世界中，那种紧张刺激的感觉……

    陈峰脚步加快，回到小区，先拐去驿站把快递取了。

    箱子不小，长条形，外面裹了厚厚的泡沫和硬纸壳，分量有些沉。

    回到出租屋。

    陈峰把门反锁，把箱子搁在客厅地板上，拿刀划开。

    泡沫填充层里，一柄黑灰色的斩刀静静躺着。

    刀长约一米一，刀身窄而直，从根部到尖端微微收窄，通体呈现出深沉的黑灰色金属光泽，刃口泛着一层冷光，肉眼可见的锋锐。

    而刀背明显加厚，表面覆着一层颗粒状的暗色甲壳层，纹理粗粝。

    刀柄则缠着黑色防滑胶带，握把处有轻微的弧度，贴合掌心。

    陈峰伸手握住刀柄，提起来。

    入手沉稳，重心偏前，适合劈砍。

    “不错不错，好刀！”

    陈峰喜滋滋的挥动了两下，又转身把墙角那把卷刃的工兵铲拿出来。

    铲面朝上，平放在地板上。

    他双手握刀，刀刃对准铲面中央，匀速下压。

    嗤——

    斩刀切入工兵铲的铲面，就如切豆腐一样，几乎没什么阻滞。

    金属被割开的声音短促而清脆，铲面上留下一道三厘米深的切口，边缘整齐。

    陈峰翻转刀身，凑近看了看刃口。

    没有崩缺，没有卷刃，甚至连肉眼可见的磨损都没有。

    “削铁如泥。”

    陈峰满意的点了点头。

    八千块加工费，花得很值。

    他把旧工兵铲收进个人空间当备用，将斩刀在手里转了两圈，正握反握各试了几下，熟悉手感。

    做完这些，陈峰开始清点这趟所需的装备。

    两张粘网陷阱，折叠状态，各有一个手动触发器。

    一枚灭巢烟弹，圆柱形铁罐，顶部有保险销。

    防毒面罩的备用滤芯，两片。

    血腥诱饵剂，深红色液体，装在密封塑料瓶里。

    再加上手里这把斩刀。

    已经差不多了……
content_en:
Chen Feng left the school and his phone vibrated.

    Pickup Reminders.

    "You have a parcel that has arrived at the Qingyun Community Station. Please collect it in time."

    Sender: Zhouji Foundry.

    The knife finally arrived!

    Chen Feng's eyes brightened slightly, and he felt happy.

    All the other equipment he ordered before has arrived, except for this knife.

    As long as he has the knife and everything is ready, he can go back to the Great Ruins World and kill the Shadow Hunter Spider!

    After not going to the Great Ruins World for twelve full days, he even began to miss the tense and exciting feeling in the Great Ruins World...

    Chen Feng quickened his pace, returned to the community, and turned to the inn to pick up the express delivery.

    The box is not small, long and wrapped in thick foam and cardboard, making it a bit heavy.

    Return to the rental house.

    Chen Feng locked the door, placed the box on the living room floor, and opened it with a knife.

    Inside the foam padding layer, a black-gray chopping knife lay quietly.

    The knife is about one meter long. The blade is narrow and straight, narrowing slightly from the root to the tip. The whole body shows a deep black-gray metallic luster. The edge of the blade is glowing with a cold light, and it is sharp to the naked eye.

    The back of the knife is obviously thickened, and the surface is covered with a granular dark carapace layer with a rough texture.

    The handle of the knife is wrapped with black anti-slip tape, and the grip has a slight arc to fit the palm of your hand.

    Chen Feng reached out and grasped the handle of the knife and lifted it up.

    The hand is steady and the center of gravity is forward, suitable for chopping.

    "Not bad, good knife!"

    Chen Feng waved it twice happily, then turned around and took out the curled-edged engineer shovel from the corner.

    Place the shovel flat on the floor with the side facing up.

    He held the knife with both hands, pointed the blade at the center of the shovel surface, and pressed down at a constant speed.

    Chi——

    The chopping knife cuts into the shovel surface of the engineer shovel, just like cutting tofu, with almost no obstruction.

    The sound of metal being cut was short and crisp, leaving a three centimeter deep cut on the shovel surface with neat edges.

    Chen Feng turned the blade over and looked closely at the blade.

    There is no chipping, no curling, or even visible wear.

    "Iron is like clay."

    Chen Feng nodded with satisfaction.

    The processing fee of 8,000 yuan is well spent.

    He put the old engineer shovel into his personal space as a spare, turned the chopping knife twice in his hand, and tried holding it in the front and back a few times to familiarize himself with the feel.

    After doing this, Chen Feng began to inventory the equipment needed for this trip.

    Two sticky web traps, folded, each with a manual trigger.

    A nest-killing cartridge, a cylindrical iron can with a safety pin on the top.

    Spare filter element for gas mask, two pieces.

    Bloody bait agent, dark red liquid, packed in a sealed plastic bottle.

    Plus the chopping knife in his hand.

    It’s almost done…
